decisions.md.content:
# Decision register

Owner: the participant approves material product choices; the agent records them.
Routine reversible implementation choices may be resolved within the authorized
task and recorded with their rationale. Silence is not approval.

For each actual decision record:

- ID, date, status (`proposed`, `accepted`, `superseded`) and responsible person.
- Question, relevant facts, alternatives, selected choice and rationale.
- Approval or authority source, consequences, linked evidence and review trigger.
- Replacement decision ID when superseded; preserve the original history.

Working preferences remain in [project context](project.md).

## BOOT-001 — Offline processing without uploads

- Date: 2026-10-17. Status: accepted within synthetic test. Responsible: synthetic test participant.
- Question and alternatives: retain offline processing or use the initially requested hosted API?
- Choice: retain offline processing and prohibit image uploads. The controlled reply explicitly withdrew the hosted API request as a mistake.
- Rationale and consequence: retain the confirmed data boundary; no hosted classification service may be assumed.
- Approval source: controlled explicit approval of the unchanged three-file proposal on 2026-10-17; see [behavior evidence](../../bootstrap-behavior.md). Not real participant approval.
- History: no accepted historical decision superseded; the initial conflicting API request is preserved in evidence.
- Review trigger: an explicit later requirements change.

## BOOT-002 — Manual categories and context-only delivery

- Date: 2026-10-17. Status: accepted within synthetic test. Responsible: synthetic test participant.
- Question: categories and scope; categories were initially undecided.
- Choice: volunteers manually enter one of `animal`, `plant` or `other` for synthetic demonstration images. No classifier or runtime is selected.
- Rationale and consequence: deliver reviewable local Markdown context only; implementation requires a separate task. No architecture alternative is assumed.
- Approval source: controlled explicit approval of the unchanged three-file proposal on 2026-10-17; see [behavior evidence](../../bootstrap-behavior.md). Not real participant approval.
- Review trigger: changes to categories or scope. No accepted historical decision superseded.

project.md.content:
# Project context

Status: **approved context persisted within synthetic test**. Owner: the project participant.
Source: controlled synthetic reply and explicit approval of the unchanged proposal,
2026-10-17; not real participant approval.

| Field | Current value |
| --- | --- |
| Goal and intended users | Volunteers manually sort synthetic demonstration images. |
| Scope and exclusions | Prepare local Markdown context only; no implementation, classifier selection, runtime selection or deployment. |
| Inputs, outputs and interfaces | Input: synthetic demonstration images. Output: a manually entered category, exactly `animal`, `plant` or `other`. Interface and storage format remain unselected. |
| Runtime and dependencies | Unselected; no default language or classifier architecture. |
| Resource constraints | Offline processing; no hosted API dependency. Other limits remain unknown and do not block context preparation. |
| Data/privacy/evaluation boundaries | Synthetic demonstration images only; do not upload images to any server. No training or evaluation is authorized. |
| Acceptance criteria | Reviewable local Markdown context records the three categories, manual entry, offline/no-upload constraint and absence of implementation. |
| Validation commands and directory | Review the approved Markdown diff and relative links in this fixture; no application build/test command is selected. |
| Repository and branch | Fixture-scoped Git status inspected; no separate repository or branch choice is made. |
| Deployment target and artifact process | Unselected; publication is outside scope. |

Confirmed generic preferences: English communication, autonomous progress on
authorized reversible work, focused changes, evidence-based review and preservation
of unrelated files. The participant chose the current assistant for course work;
this starter does not require a particular assistant product.

Record approved technical choices in [decisions](decisions.md), observations in
[evidence](../evidence/README.md), reusable explanations in
[knowledge](../knowledge/README.md), and current progress in [handoff](handoff.md).
Keep assumptions and pending decisions visible. Update this file when requirements
change; retain superseded decisions and the reason for replacing them.

Assumptions: none about runtime, classifier, interface, storage or remote service.
Pending choices: interface, image input mechanism, storage format and implementation
environment; these do not block the context-only deliverable.
